vMatrix.notes: Re-verified 2026-09-12 directly against the class doc's own PRIORITY BOOST NODES / FILLER BOOST NODES table. The class doc says a Xenon being pushed as a main should eventually max all six boost nodes, but that only the four priority nodes matter for damage and for unlocking the 6th job Mastery Cores. NamuWiki's KMS skill page independently lists the same six boost node cores with the same skill groupings, and independently states that the four cores containing the mastery core skills are the ones that must be strengthened - so both the GROUPINGS and the priority-four set have two independent sources. TIER CAVEAT: Grandis Library groups all six identically but tiers them Primary (Mecha Purge; Triangulation/Hypogram Field/Entangling Lash), Secondary (Salvo System/Orbital Cataclysm/Gravity Pillar; Beam Dance/Combat Switch) and Other (the two filler nodes). An earlier revision of this file cited Grandis as calling all four 'primary'; it does not. Grandis is in any case a restatement - its per-class credits attribute the boost node build to the Xenon Discord - so it never counts as a second independent vote. A separately authored cross-class trio table (mastermysty, page dated 2024-11-21) groups the trios differently - see conflicts. The class doc also advises fast levellers to avoid levelling Decent skills other than Decent Holy Symbol and Decent Holy Fountain, and to disassemble the rest into priority nodes.

gearingNotes:
Xenon is the only class that uses STR, DEX and LUK together, and that changes gearing in four concrete ways that no generic guide will tell you.

1. THIEF OR PIRATE. Xenon can equip both Thief and Pirate gear (the Mimic Protocol passive). Set bonuses only apply across matching class gear, so mixing a Thief hat with a Pirate top forfeits the set bonus. The class doc's instruction is to pick one class of gear early and stay consistent; which one does not matter mechanically. On Interactive worlds it recommends Thief gear because it is more common on the Auction House.

2. GENESIS WEAPON MUST MATCH. The Genesis Energy Chain comes in Thief and Pirate versions - Thief gives 150 LUK and 150 DEX, Pirate gives 150 STR and 150 DEX - and it must match the class of the Eternal gear. Players without Eternal gear yet should match their Arcane gear and keep every later piece consistent. The mismatch is recoverable: once three pieces of a set are equipped, the weapon counts toward the set bonus regardless of which version was chosen; below three pieces it does not.

3. POTENTIALS COST MORE. Xenon wants percent All Stat on non-WSE gear, which the class doc calls out as roughly two to three times more expensive than a normal class's main-stat lines when chasing three lines. WSE potentials and starforcing cost the same as any other class. The doc's stated progression order is: two lines All Stat plus random, then two lines All Stat plus a single STR/DEX/LUK line, then two prime All Stat lines plus random, then two prime All Stat lines plus a single-stat line, then three All Stat lines. It also gives a comparison formula: All-Stat-equivalent = (percent All Stat) + one third of (percent STR, DEX or LUK), which makes a single-stat line worth about a third of an All Stat line.

4. FLAME SCORING IS DIFFERENT. Because all three stats count, the class doc's flame formula is (STR + DEX + LUK) + (Attack Power x 5) + (percent All Stat x 20), rather than the single-main-stat formula used for other classes.

ABILITY POINTS. 330 points must go into each of STR, DEX and LUK before any can be specialised. The class doc's default is to keep the three even, because the relative value of each shifts every time gear or potentials change; only once cubing is effectively finished at a given progression level does it recommend pushing excess points past 330 into whichever stat the character has the highest percentage of, and it says re-cubing an item purely to swap one single-stat line is never worth it.

OTHER. Xenon is not a buff duration class - the doc says its main use is extending the Angelic Buster link skill buff. Summon duration is similarly low value: only Hypogram Field: Force Field is affected by general summon duration, while Hypogram Field: Fusion is reached only by the Hypogram Field - Persist hyper passive. Crit rate is built to 100% and no further, with the Perspective Shift passive contributing up to 40%.

commonMistakes.mistake: Mixing Thief and Pirate gear across a set, which silently forfeits the set bonus.
Choosing a Genesis weapon that does not match the class of your Eternal gear. Below three set pieces the weapon does not count toward the set bonus.
Building crit rate to 100% without Decent Sharp Eyes active, which overshoots and wastes hyper stat points during actual bossing.
Pushing the Attack Power hyper stat past level 6, or crit rate past level 10.

Using the Ascent skill Neoteric Snap inside the burst window. The class doc states it gains nothing from buffs such as Maple World Goddess's Blessing, Last Resort or familiars, so casting it during burst wastes the time; it should be used off-burst or as an i-frame.
Trying to optimise HEXA Stat lines before all HEXA cores are maxed, rather than simply unlocking them and taking each to 20/20.
Spending V points on the two filler boost nodes (Diagonal Chase / Horizon Driver / Ion Thrust, and Beam Spline / Quicksilver) before the four priority nodes that gate the HEXA Mastery Cores.
Levelling Decent skills other than Decent Holy Symbol and Decent Holy Fountain while rushing levels, instead of disassembling them into priority nodes.
Re-cubing an item purely to swap a single STR/DEX/LUK potential line for a different single stat.

sources.what: The Roo-D Files (The Official Xenon Guide) - the Xenon Mains Discord's maintained class doc, written by BeefTech (B E E F / Chip) with the Xenon Discord. Scopes itself explicitly to Heroic. Carries inner ability, hyper stats, link skills, ability points, equipment (Thief vs Pirate, Genesis weapon, potentials, flame score), 5th job boost nodes and node leveling priority, 6th job Origin/Ascent/Mastery/Boost/Common node explanations, a HEXA leveling priority chart, HEXA stat guidance and burst rotations. Self-flags only its Culvert section as out of date. Read through a browser; the /export?format=txt route also works once via its single-use redirect.

Grandis Library Xenon page - boost node Primary/Secondary/Other tiering, hyper skill passive build, recommended inner ability bossing and training, class properties, link skill and legion effect. NOT an independent vote: Grandis per-class pages credit inner ability, hyper passive build and boost nodes to the Class Doc, so for those three fields it restates the Roo-D Files. Useful as a structured cross-check that the doc was read correctly. No HEXA section.

coverageWarnings: The HEXA investment ORDER - the single most valuable field for this class - was NOT extracted and is still not extracted. The class doc has a current, Heroic-specific, fragment-optimised chart, but it is icon-encoded and only the level numbers survive text extraction. No order has been invented. Resolving this needs a vision pass over the doc or a human reading the chart. This is a coverage GAP, not an unverified claim - nothing in hexa.order asserts an order the doc does not state.

Sourcing ceiling for this class: only one current, high-quality GMS judgement source exists (the Roo-D Files). NamuWiki is a genuine second independent judgement source but carries KMS balance, and it only speaks to V skill core order and boost node groupings - it says nothing about GMS hyper stats, inner ability or HEXA order. mastermysty is independent but predates v.269. Grandis Library credits its inner ability, hyper passive and boost node builds to the Xenon Discord, so it restates the class doc and never counts as a second vote. hyperStats, innerAbility, hyper passives and HEXA stat are therefore all correctly labelled sourceCount 1 / weak.

Two defects remain open and were deliberately left untouched as out of scope for this endgame-only wave: secondaryWeapon 'Core Controller' and the 'Genesis Energy Chain' weapon name in gearingNotes. Neither affects the five endgame sections, but both should be settled before any gearing feature ships.
No reddit source was consulted - reddit is blocked in this environment.
No YouTube guide descriptions were checked. NamuWiki and Grandis Library were re-read in a browser this pass; both return 403 to plain fetching and NamuWiki sits behind a Cloudflare interstitial.
